email_subject: Application - Video Content Creator Internship (TikTok Focus)
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Video Content Creator Internship (TikTok Focus) at The Skateroom. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, SEO, and social media, I am excited about the opportunity to bring my skills to your mission-driven brand.

In my current role at Episto, I create keyword-targeted content and manage WordPress sites, but my passion lies in short-form video. I have developed a strong eye for composition, rhythm, and storytelling through my own projects, including building mirook.com from scratch. I am a TikTok native who understands trends and what makes content scroll-stopping. I am comfortable shooting and editing on my phone using CapCut and other tools, and I am eager to collaborate with your Comms Director to develop concepts that match The Skateroom's tone.

I am proactive, curious, and not afraid to pitch ideas. I am also drawn to the intersection of art, skate culture, and social impact, which makes this internship a perfect fit.

I would love to discuss how I can contribute to your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am thrilled to apply for the Video Content Creator Internship (TikTok Focus) at The Skateroom. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in content creation and a deep appreciation for art and skate culture, I am eager to help tell your story through engaging short-form video.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my skills in content strategy, on-page SEO, and WordPress site management. While my work has been primarily text-based, I have always been drawn to visual storytelling. I am a TikTok native who spends hours analyzing trends, understanding what makes people stop scrolling, and experimenting with editing techniques using CapCut and other mobile tools. I have a good eye for composition and rhythm, and I am not afraid to jump in front of the camera when needed.

One of my proudest projects is mirook.com, a website I designed and built for a Belgian youth chess champion. I handled everything from site structure to social media integration, and I implemented structured data to improve visibility. This project taught me how to create content that resonates with a specific audience and how to iterate based on performance.

I am particularly drawn to The Skateroom because of its mission to empower youth through skateboarding and art. I believe that creative content can drive social change, and I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your global impact. I am proactive, curious, and always ready to pitch new ideas. I am also comfortable working remotely and collaborating with a team.

I would love to bring my creativity, technical skills, and passion for storytelling to The Skateroom. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Warm regards,

Baver Ok
